# Distortion › Pixel

**What belongs here.** The image breaks into pixels or sorted pixels.

**Examples.** pixelate, mosaic, pixel sort, dither

**Family test.** Do the pixels bend, smear, glitch, pixelate or scatter?

Each transition here has its own folder named by its id (lowercase, hyphens). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Transitions

| Transition | Summary |
|---|---|
| [Pixelate](pixelate/) | The picture breaks into growing blocks of pixels, swaps at the coarsest point, then sharpens into the new scene. |
